title: question_bank
description: Exam-style question bank for the clerkship SPA, separate from topic_meta.json. Quality bar: QUESTION_BANK_STANDARD.md; categories/counts: QUESTION_BANK_BLUEPRINT.md. This schema documents the shape for editors; the drafting checklist in QUESTION_BANK_EXECUTION_BRIEF.md is the enforced check. All strings are plain text (HTML-escaped on render). Item ids and option keys are stable identities — SRS cards (QB#<id>), response records (cw_qb_v1), and future cohort aggregation key on them; never renumber or reuse.

id.description: Stable forever. Prefix matches the blueprint category's canonical prefix — mood, psy, anx, sud, cog, pha, saf, per, cdev, otherdx, eth, rel (e.g. qb_sud_001). Enforced semantically by validate_registry_schemas.py; qb_chd_001/002 and qb_oth_001/002 are grandfathered legacy ids.

status.description: Drafting models always write 'draft'. Only faculty attest tooling sets 'attested'.

hy.description: Scarce (≤ 1/3 of items); omit rather than false.

pages.description: Deployed slugs the item is derived from; must include one from the item's blueprint category.

stem.description: Clinical vignette ending in a positive lead-in; answerable with options covered.

key.description: Stable identity; renderer may shuffle display order.

c.description: Present on exactly one option per item.

name.description: Named misconception, 2–6 words, reusable across items (see brief vocabulary).

note.description: One line of better thinking that dispatches it.

why.description: Dispatches the traps by name, then states the discriminator.

pearl.description: One keepable line — ideally the source page's own pearl.

evidence.description: The anchor exactly as a `pages` source states it — never a new outside citation.

retired.description: Non-destructive retirement flag. When true the item is excluded from the shipped/attestable set (status must be 'draft'); it is never deleted so its stable id and response history survive. Only faculty/reviewer tooling sets this; retired items cannot be re-attested.

retiredReason.description: One line explaining why the item was retired (e.g., near-duplicate of qb_sud_009).

tier2.description: Required iff type is 'two-tier'. Options are competing rationales; the strong distractor rationales mirror the tier-1 traps.

v2.description: Reserved hooks — v1 authors write nothing here; renderers ignore unknown keys. Confidence weighting and cohort reveal need no per-item authoring: response records in cw_qb_v1 carry {id, option key, tier2 key, confidence, correct, ts}.

case.description: Sequential/unfolding cases: items sharing caseId render in step order; stems are cumulative.

blockTag.description: Adaptive-difficulty block label; the picker otherwise uses category + difficulty + id.
